scope: all tcb/*.py plus trusted bootstrap.py and deployment adapters/*.py; every line is counted in exactly one budget

safety.modules: every module not listed in another budget, plus bootstrap.py and adapters/*.py
safety.guarantee: no forbidden effect, no forbidden widening, no rewritten history: a bug here can let something through

restrict_only.guarantee: second judge, joined by AND: it runs only after the kernel admitted, and its disagreement or failure halts. A bug here can stop the journal, never admit what the kernel refuses (tests/test_budget_classification.py)

visibility.guarantee: gaps stay visible: a bug here can hide or invent a gap in health, never admit an entry or send an effect; no safety module imports it

review: The safety ceiling is the historical 2,942 lines. The two others only move by a decision recorded here, never to pass the check by compaction. Moving code between budgets is such a decision too: a module belongs to restrict_only or visibility only while its importers guard and its test hold.

decisions.why: root-cause fixes of the V6 review: the second judge restates the effect-line automaton, the closed envelope and independent gates (docs/REVUE-V6.md)
a debt follows the (resource, property) it measures, not the target's name (docs/REVUE-V6.md, finding 6)
